stop teaching `traigent next-steps RUN_ID --json`, which the SDK RETIRED on 2026-08-03 (Traigent 9b308539 'retire legacy analytics next steps'; the sibling 6aff6ee7 retired `traigent guidance`). Verified by introspecting both SDKs: the command is PRESENT in 0.19.1.dev0 (the version this repo's contract venv installs) and ABSENT from 0.26.0 on origin/develop, whose CLI exposes 26 commands with no next-steps or guidance. It is therefore dead on any current install while this repo's own guard still sees it as live. The skill already documented the real path -- the example-scoring dataset-quality output -- but presented it as the fallback, so a reader hit the retired command first. The real path is now primary. `traigent report-example-map` (step 2) was confirmed present in both and is unchanged. Part of Traigent/traigent-skills#251; fixes only the 2 refs in this skill.
